summary: Make checkpoint proof wait coverage independent of host scheduling by sharing the Tokio clock between its deadline and polling timer.

replay.detail: No replay or projection change. Checkpoint planning and proof still use the same staged state.

schema.detail: No stored format, claim or database schema change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, digest or fleet coordination change. Members can upgrade in any order.

compatibility.detail: No API, client, protocol or harness change. Outside paused-time tests, the Tokio deadline reads the same monotonic clock as before; the 60 s wait and 250 ms poll interval are unchanged.

downtime.detail: Install with the usual daemon restart; no additional service interruption or startup work.

manual.detail: No configuration or manual migration is required for any starting version or state.

recovery.detail: Revert to the previous binary; the change persists no state.
